title: extensions.recipe_catalog
description: Budgets for the catalogue block run_recipe_query publishes in its tools/list description. Both keys are optional; an omitted key keeps its shipped default. The block is rendered whole while it fits the block budget; past it, per-query descriptions are shortened largest-first (never below name and parameters) and only far enough to fit; names alone are published only when names and parameters together already exceed the budget. Skill bodies the framework appends after the block are not counted here.

block_budget.description: Longest rendered catalogue block, in bytes.

description_budget.description: Longest per-query description, in characters, once shortening begins. A shortened description is marked with a trailing ellipsis. 0 drops the prose entirely and keeps every recipe.query name and its parameter line.
